sections.text: You're listening to the Skeptics' Guide to the Universe, your escape to reality.
sections.title: Introduction

sections.text: I would like to know what books you would recommend for a beginning skeptic. I have had 'The Demon-Haunted World' since it first came out, but would like to expand my library. What magazines would you recommend for one to subscribe to.Thank youMichael ShrodeEvansville, U.S.A.

Question #1: For the first time scientists have filmed a single electron.
Question #2: A new study finds that some species of bats have internal magnetic fields that aid them in locating prey.
Question #3: Forensic scientists have discovered how to track a person's travel by examining their hair.
